Lily Li-Jan Lin 林麗貞, Conductor

台灣臺中縣人，1982年畢業於台灣國立師範大學音樂系，主修聲樂，副修鋼琴。並於 1987年進入師大音樂敎育研究所。曾致力於國民中小學音樂敎育及培養師資，執敎師範 學院音樂系共歷14載。於1990年來美定居於橙縣芳泉谷。來美後多次獨唱演出頗獲嘉評 肯定。近歷指揮敎導＂爾灣青少年合唱團＂、＂南橙縣婦女合唱團＂並任職於爾灣中文學 校合唱團指揮。

This biography is preserved from the original archive.
 
 

Notable Accomplishments

Taught music at the Teachers College level for 14 years in Taiwan, dedicated to music education in primary and secondary schools and teacher training

Performed multiple solo vocal concerts after immigrating to the United States, receiving favorable reviews

Conducted the Irvine Youth Chorus, South Orange County Women's Chorus, and Irvine Chinese School Chorus

Devoted 14 years to music education at the elementary and junior high school level in Taiwan, training teachers

Performed multiple well-received solo vocal concerts after immigrating to the US

Conducted Irvine Youth Choir, South Orange County Women's Chorus, and Irvine Chinese School Chorus
